inputs.prompt: In image 1, change only the man's pose and expression. He has just woken up: he lies on his back in the same place in the bed, his head sunk in the pillow, looking up, his eyes just opened, with a small, soft, rested smile and closed lips (no teeth showing). No arm is raised in the air: the arm that was up now lies bent on the pillow beside his head, with the elbow and the forearm resting on the pillow and the hand relaxed and half open next to his hair. His other hand still rests on the duvet over his stomach. He is the man of image 2 and image 3, in the same dark charcoal T-shirt. The dark smartphone still lies on the bedside table. He is the only person in the room. Keep everything else in the picture exactly the same: the same room, camera, framing, bed, duvet, furniture and warm sunrise light.

expect.unit: USD (the endpoint bills in units of 1 dollar, by tokens)
expect.basis: the 2K edits on this model cost 6.5 to 9 cents each today (demo-video/ledger/wp3.csv)

note: M1a3: a calmer first frame for morning-wake: arm resting on the pillow, closed-lip smile (an edit of morning-wake-a.png; helper wp3-morning)
